description: Add redirect_uri to EnterpriseConnection.oauth_config. The spec omits it, but Clerk returns it on OIDC enterprise connections (GET/POST/PATCH /enterprise_connections): it is the callback URL the admin must register with their identity provider, so a caller configuring OIDC SSO needs it. @clerk/backend's EnterpriseConnection class also drops it, which is why callers have read it from the raw JSON. Optional and nullable, like the sibling client_id and discovery_url members. Not yet confirmed with a live probe.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The OAuth callback URL to register with the identity provider
